<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><b>Explanatory Note</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span id="xdx_90D_edei--AmendmentDescription_c20261030__20261030_zrzdy7cEb9oe"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-10-30" id="Fact000027" name="dei:AmendmentDescription">This Amendment No. 1 on Form 8-K/A amends and restates Items 5.02 and 7.01 of the Current Report on Form 8-K filed by KiNRG, Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) with the Securities and
Exchange Commission on November 5, 2026 (the &#8220;Original Form 8-K&#8221;), to correct and update certain disclosures regarding changes
in the Company&#8217;s and TRINITY Group Construction, Inc.&#8217;s management and board composition. Items 5.02 and 7.01 are amended
and restated in their entirety as set forth below. Except as expressly set forth herein, no other changes have been made to the Original Form 8-K.</ix:nonNumeric></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="background-color: white"><b>Item
5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of
Certain Officers.</b></span><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Departure of Directors</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 31, 2026, Troy A. Herring resigned
as a member of the Board, Audit Committee and Compensation Committee with immediate effect. Mr. Herring&#8217;s resignation was not the
result of any disagreement with Company on any matter relating to the Company&#8217;s operations, policies, or practices.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 2, 2026, Livian L. Jones resigned
as a member of the Board, Compensation Committee and Nominating and Governance Committee with immediate effect. Ms. Jones&#8217; resignation
was not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company&#8217;s operations, policies, or practices.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 3, 2026, Mossadaq Chughtai resigned
as a member of the Board, Audit Committee and Nominating and Governance Committee with immediate effect. Mr. Chughtai&#8217;s resignation
was not the result of any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company&#8217;s operations, policies, or practices.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Appointment of Directors</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 4, 2026, the Board appointed Arthur
Dammarrel and Jon Vincent as members of the Board to fill two of the vacancies created by recent departures. Mr. Vincent was appointed
to serve as Chair of the Audit Committee, and Mr. Dammarrel was appointed to serve on the Audit Committee, Compensation Committee and
Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Departure of President</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>&#160;</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On October 30, 2026, Millard &#8220;Flip&#8221;
Wallen, III resigned as the President of the Company with immediate effect. Mr. Wallen&#8217;s resignation was not the result of any disagreement
with the Company on any matter relating to the Company&#8217;s operations, policies, or practices.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><i>Appointment of Chief Operating Officer</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">On November 4, 2026, John Vasilj was appointed
as the Company&#8217;s Chief Operating Officer.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Mr. Vasilj is a seasoned business transformation
executive with extensive experience partnering with corporate and government leaders to drive growth and increase operational efficiency
through technology integration and innovating at scale. His background includes leading the build and delivery of several billion USD
in revenue around large-scale digital and AI initiatives as Accenture&#8217;s US Industrial Services Lead, US Mid-Market Lead and Lead
of North America Transportation, among other roles. As Chief Technology Officer of the Chicago Transit Authority, Mr. Vasilj led the expansive
technology, security, and next generation data infrastructure portfolio of one of the nation&#8217;s largest public transportation systems,
receiving multiple awards including the Chicago Innovation Award. His early career experience involved international real estate development
and management and serving multiple posts as foreign service staff of the Republic of Croatia. Mr. Vasilj earned a Government and International
Relations degree from Georgetown University.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="background-color: white"><b>Item
7.01. Regulation FD Disclosure</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="background-color: white">On October
30, 2026, Mil L. &#8220;Flip&#8221; Wallen III retired as Chief Executive Officer of </span>TRINITY Group Construction, Inc. (&#8220;TRINITY&#8221;)<span style="background-color: white">,
a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, following nearly 25 years with TRINITY. Mr. Wallen, who founded TRINITY in 2002, will continue
to serve in a consulting capacity as Founder and Strategic Advisor, supporting TRINITY&#8217;s business development and the Company&#8217;s
broader strategic initiatives.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Ronald Pickett, CEO of KiNRG was elected President
of TRINITY. <span style="background-color: white">Reginald J. Arnold II, who previously served as President of TRINITY, has succeeded
Mr. Wallen as Chief Executive Officer of TRINITY. Mr. Arnold and TRINITY&#8217;s leadership team will report to Ronald Pickett, Chief
Executive Officer of the Company and President of TRINITY, with support from John Vasilj, Chief Operating Officer of the Company. The
remainder of TRINITY&#8217;s executive leadership team remains unchanged.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
